subject.name: Food and Nutrition
subject.description: Food and Nutrition syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: TOPIC 1.2 NUTRITION
topics.description: This topic provides a comprehensive overview of nutrition to empower learners to make informed dietary choices and apply practical skills in real-world scenarios. It covers nutritional terms, food groups, food nutrients, and nutritional disorders.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.2.1: Nutritional terms
sub_topics.description: Focuses on exploring and interpreting diverse nutritional terms, assessing nutritional status through anthropometric measurements and dietary assessments, and visiting health centers to identify potential nutrient deficiencies or excesses.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.2.2: Food groups
sub_topics.description: Focuses on exploring different food groups, illustrating the food pyramid diagram, and creating serving portions and choices necessary for maintaining a balanced and healthy diet.

sub_topics.name: Sub- Topic:1.2.3: Food Nutrients
sub_topics.description: Examines macronutrients, micronutrients, and essential elements in the diet, assessing the nutritional value of foods, producing materials for nutrient determination, and conducting food tests.

sub_topics.name: Sub Topic:1.2. 4: Nutritional Disorders
sub_topics.description: Examines conditions resulting from overnutrition, undernutrition, and psychological eating habits, analyzing their causes, signs, symptoms, and risk factors while promoting healthy eating habits.

topics.name: TOPIC: 1.3 DIGESTION, ABSORPTION AND METABOLISM OF NUTRIENTS
topics.description: This topic covers the physiological mechanisms underlying digestion, absorption, and metabolism to help learners understand how the body breaks down and utilizes food nutrients. It guides learners in tracing nutrient pathways and making evidence-based dietary choices to maintain physiological equilibrium.

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic 1.3.1 - Digestion of Nutrients
sub_topics.description: Explores physical and chemical digestion at various stages of the alimentary canal, illustrating the digestive system, and researching the physiological processes involved in breaking down food.

competencies.description: Trace the path way of food through digestion

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic 1.3.2 ABSORPTION OF NUTRIENTS
sub_topics.description: Explains mechanisms of nutrient transport across the intestinal wall—such as simple diffusion, facilitated diffusion, and active transport—analyzing the structure of villi and factors affecting absorption.

competencies.description: Make dietary and lifestyle choices to optimize nutrient absorption and overall health.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.3.3: Metabolism
sub_topics.description: Analyzes the biochemical processes of anabolism and catabolism, examines factors affecting body energy usage, and guides the design of personalized nutritional plans based on metabolic needs.

topics.name: 1.4 COOKING FOOD
topics.description: Cooking is a vital life skill that empowers individuals to prepare nutritious meals, fostering independence, creativity, and healthy eating habits. This topic introduces learners to foundational culinary concepts, including basic cookery terms alongside essential cooking techniques, energy sources for cooking, heat transfer mechanisms, and methods of cooking.

competencies.description: Developing skills in teamwork, communication, and problem-solving. Engage in hands-on cooking sessions, peer assessments, and project-based learning.
Experimenting with ingredients and cooking techniques. Adapting recipes and coming up with innovative culinary solutions.
Understanding and application of scientific principles (heat transfer). Ability to analyze and evaluate information.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.4.5: COOKERY TERMS
sub_topics.description: Cooking is an essential life skill that allows people to prepare healthy, delicious, and balanced meals. During cooking, learners are introduced to basic cookery terms such as au gratin, croutons, sauté, and bake blind, to help them understand different cooking techniques as a foundation of culinary skills.
learning_objectives: Interpreting cookery terms: (Au gratin, croutons, bake blind…).
Demonstrating the use of cookery terms in meal preparations (poaching, dredge, julienned, poaching...).
Preparing dishes using specific cooking terms: (potato au gratin, Sauté, Stir-fry).

competencies.description: Apply cookery terms in meal preparation

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.4.6: Fuel
sub_topics.description: Cooking food requires energy, and that energy comes from various sources known as fuels. Fuels are substances that release energy when they are burned or combusted, providing the heat needed to cook food. Learners explore various fuels, their advantages, disadvantages, safe usage, climate impacts, and alternative energy sources.
learning_objectives: Discussing different types of fuel: (solid, liquid, solar…).
Comparing and contrasting different types of fuel.
Researching on the other sources of fuel: (bio gas, solar…).

competencies.description: Make use of different types of fuel

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.4.7: Heat Transfer
sub_topics.description: This sub-topic highlights the transfer of heat that results into cooking of food. Heat transfer is a process by which thermal energy moves from one place to another due to temperature difference. Heat transfer occurs through three primary mechanisms, namely conduction, convection and radiation.
learning_objectives: Analysing methods of heat transfer: (Conduction, convection, radiation…).
Associating methods of heat transfer to methods of cooking: (Radiation - grilling, convection - boiling, conduction – (dry or shallow) frying…).

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.4.7: Methods of cooking
sub_topics.description: Cooking is a fundamental human activity, transforming raw ingredients into palatable and nutritious meals. It's a blend of art and science, where understanding various cooking methods is crucial for achieving desired textures, flavours, and nutritional outcomes.
learning_objectives: Discussing methods of cooking food: (Moist, dry, combination...).
Preparing and cooking dishes using different methods of cooking: (Festival dishes – Matebeto, chilanga mulilo, weddings…).

competencies.description: Prepare dishes using various methods of cooking
